item.title: Trump Criticizes Supreme Court Over Mail Ballot Loss
item.description: President Trump has harshly criticized the Supreme Court over a recent ruling on mail ballots, questioning his appointees' decisions.

item.title: Supreme Court Rejects Trump's Restrictions on Voting by Mail
item.description: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump’s efforts to limit mail-in voting, safeguarding the rights of millions of American voters during the 2020 election.

item.title: Supreme Court Halt Trump's USPS Mail-Ballot Screening Plan
item.description: The Supreme Court has blocked Trump's administration from implementing rules to screen mail-in ballots, creating a second roadblock for USPS mail-ballot rules.

item.title: Supreme Court Blocks Mail Ballot Restrictions for Midterms
item.description: The US Supreme Court has blocked state mail ballot restrictions ahead of the midterm elections, upholding the right to vote by mail in key states.

item.title: Trump Criticizes AI Leader, Advocates for 'Smart President'
item.description: President Trump criticizes an AI company leader who called for slowing down AI development, instead advocating for a 'smart president' to act as a guardrail.

item.title: Iran War Updates: Oil Prices Jump as Hormuz Talks Postponed
item.description: Oil prices surge to a near 4-month high as talks between Iran and Oman on the Strait of Hormuz are postponed, amid ongoing Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Congress Awakened by AI Dangers, but Action on Hold
item.description: Dire warnings about AI have shocked Congress, but political priorities may delay action until after the election.

item.title: Trump Resists AI Slowdown Despite Political Challenges
item.description: Despite political pressures, Trump remains committed to advancing AI technology, fearing a slowdown could put the US at a disadvantage against China.

item.title: Johnson Urges AI Solutions, Claims Congress Won't Lead
item.description: Johnson calls for AI solutions, but Congress won't take the lead, as tech leaders urge action to address growing fears and concerns.

item.title: El Niño's Impact on the Slowest Atlantic Hurricane Season
item.description: El Niño is creating conditions for a record-low Atlantic hurricane season. Learn why the Atlantic has been unusually quiet this year.

item.title: Saudi Oil Pipeline Closure: Iraq Under Pressure
item.description: Saudi Arabia's closure of a critical oil pipeline after drone attacks from Iraq has put the country under pressure. Learn about the geopolitical implications.

item.title: Yemen Crisis: 50,000 Civilians Flee as Houthis Advance
item.description: Over 50,000 civilians flee as the Houthis expand their control along Yemen's Red Sea coast. Learn about the impact and international reaction to the crisis.

item.title: Houthi Capture Threatens Red Sea Shipping
item.description: Yemen’s Houthi forces capture a strategic Red Sea island, potentially disrupting global shipping routes and economic stability in the region.
